props.name: beforeCreate
props.description:
A function that returns an item to the #add template. Can be used to populate data that the user should not input themself e.g. an id.
Or to give the user suggestions for inputs. If the prop is not used an empty item will be returned.

props.name: beforeSubmit
props.description:
If given, this function is called before the [[submit]] event is emitted.
See <f-validation-form> `beforeSubmit` props for more info.

props.name: beforeValidation
props.description:
If given, this function is called before the form data is validated and the [[submit]] event is emitted.
See <f-validation-form> `beforeValidation` props for more info.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: If given, this function is called after the modal has been closed.

props.name: addNewModalHeader
props.description: Property for changing the "add new" modal heading

props.name: modifyModalHeader
props.description: Property for changing the "modify" modal heading

props.name: deleteModalHeader
props.description: Property for changing the "delete" modal heading

default.value:
TranslationService.provider.translate(
    "fkui.crud-dataset.modal.header.delete",
    "Är du säker på att du vill ta bort raden?",
)

props.name: formModalSize
props.description: Property for changing the "add" and "modify" modal size

events.name: created
events.description: Emitted when an item is added.

events.name: deleted
events.description: Emitted when an item is deleted.

events.name: updated
events.description: Emitted when an item is updated.

slots.name: add-button
slots.description: Slot for changing the text in "Add new" button`

slots.name: add
slots.description: Slot for inputs when creating a new item. The new item is available through `v-slot="{ item }"`. If any data in the item should be set not by the user the prop `beforeCreate` can be used to set that data.

bindings.name: item
bindings.description: Item returned by `beforeCreate` or an empty object.

slots.name: modify
slots.description: Slot for inputs when modifying an item. The item being modified is available through `v-slot="{ item }"`.

bindings.name: item
bindings.description: A clone of the current item.

slots.name: delete
slots.description: Slot for displaying a warning message before an item is deleted. The item being deleted is available through `v-slot="{ item }"`.
